findings.claim: Routing validation executes Python from the checkout it inspects, even with reporting disabled
findings.evidence: check_skill_routing_roles: the gate path reads declarations only; evidence (resolver load) runs only under --report. test_skill_routing_gate_runs_no_resolver.py (3 tests).
findings.fix: load the resolver from the validator's own checkout, pass the target catalog as data, and compute reachability only for --report.
findings.repro: run the trusted check_skill_routing_roles.py --repo-root <checkout> against a checkout with an unresolved front-door skill and a resolver whose module body raises a sentinel exception; the exception reaches the caller

findings.claim: The artifact gate treats an explicitly empty outputs field as absent
findings.evidence: outputs: null now refused through the shared fm.artifacts.shape call in skill_artifact_schema.subset_defect; case added to test_check_skill_artifact_flow_shipped_shape.py.
findings.fix: distinguish an absent field from a declared value and validate the type whenever the field is present.
findings.repro: add metadata: with an indented outputs: null to a non-lifecycle template; the gate accepts it even though ADR-123 requires a mapping

findings.claim: fm.artifacts.shape accepts an integer path as a string because the stdlib parser represents both as strings
findings.evidence: _lint_frontmatter_checks._entry_problems refuses a plain YAML core-type path; quoted "123" passes. test_artifact_path_must_be_text_not_a_yaml_core_type (4 cases).
findings.fix: check the scalar type before applying the path regex, while allowing quoted "123".
findings.repro: lint an output with path: 123; skillforge returns PASS, the artifact gate rejects it

findings.claim: A baselined front door without intents can add unroutable phrases without tripping the ratchet
findings.evidence: front-door-phrases-without-intents now one identity per unroutable phrase; baseline regenerated 25 -> 70; test_a_baselined_skill_cannot_add_an_unroutable_phrase.
findings.repro: add "implement my changes today" after build's existing positive phrases and before Do NOT; the resolver returns none, but the only violation remains the baselined build this

findings.claim: An inherited MUST failure masks additional violations of the same rule
findings.evidence: added_failures compares messages within a rule and returns only new ones; two tests in test_lint_added_failures.py.
findings.fix: compare finding identities within each rule.
findings.repro: pass new_failures an incumbent with outputs.old.path: /outside and a candidate that also adds outputs.new.path: ../outside; the linter reports two violations, but new_failures returns []

findings.claim: The bare architecture decision record intent sends an ADR review request to the authoring skill
findings.evidence: adr-generator intent is now 'write architecture decision record'; negative fixture lt-adr-generator-review-record-negative routes none.
findings.fix: qualify the intent with an authoring verb and add this request as a negative routing case.
findings.repro: resolve_route.py --request 'Review this architecture decision record.' selects adr-generator

findings.claim: A status-only request selects a workflow that invokes the comment responder
findings.evidence: pr-review intent is now 'comments and tell me if it can merge'; status-only request routes none (fixture lt-pr-review-status-only-negative); lt-pr-review-merge-verdict still passes.
findings.fix: require comment-response wording in the intent.
findings.repro: resolve_route.py --request 'For PR 123, tell me if it can merge. Just report the status.' selects pr-review

findings.claim: The consolidated skill omits the CONTEXT_MODE header required by all six criteria files
findings.evidence: pr-quality step 4 sets CONTEXT_MODE full or partial and step 5 applies it; contract test added.
findings.fix: supply the verified context mode before applying the criteria.
findings.repro: follow step 5 for /pr-quality --axis qa on a complete diff; the QA criteria treat the missing header as partial context and forbid PASS

findings.claim: The consolidated skill drops natural-language axis triggers that its migrated evals still expect to work
findings.evidence: pr-quality gains intent 'gate before push'; fixtures for security and qa gate phrases route to pr-quality.
findings.fix: route those phrases to pr-quality and select the named axis.
findings.repro: resolve 'Run the security gate before I push' or 'Run the qa gate before I push'; both return none

overlap_rule: same file and line within 3 of a critic path:line or range
